description.desc_thousand_char: ARK Chemicals Private Limited (ACPL) is a chemical trading company. It offers silicone defoamers/antifoams, silicones, fumed silica, silicone emulsions, paints, coatings, construction, and silanes. It caters to agrochemicals, adhesives, car care, cable and wires, construction chemicals, food and beverage, fragrance, inks,  home care,  oil and gas, paper, and many more. The company is an authorized distributor of Wacker, Wacker Metroark, Sunshield Chemicals Ltd, Arxada, Clariant, and many more. The company was incorporated in 2007 and has its registered office located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
